title: Military, First Responder and Senior Programs on Expedite Fees
content:
The discount program on a window contract carries through to the expedite fee: for Factory Production Orders built on an expedited schedule, the program discount follows the discount program on the window contract the order builds:

| Discount program on that contract | Taken off |
|---|---|
| military or first responder | 15 percent |
| senior | 10 percent |
| no program | nothing |

The discount is taken off the amount reached once the expedite charges have been summed and raised to the class minimum expedite fee where they fell below it; the fee is then rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Records read

The program is the single discount program applied at signing of the Window Replacement Contracts contract the order builds, as that contract's record shows it.

## Hypothetical examples

| Amount after the minimum | Program | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| 400.00 | military | 400.00 less 15 percent, 340.00 |
| 400.00 | first responder | 340.00 |
| 400.00 | senior | 400.00 less 10 percent, 360.00 |
| 195.00 | senior | 175.50 |
| 400.00 | none | 400.00 |

The 195.00 row shows that the discount is taken after the minimum: the fee can end below the class minimum once a program discount is taken off.
